lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, tell us how you got down there.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He drove down there and he put it back by the trees and covered it with branches and a hood.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: How did you get down there? What route did you take?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who put the stuff on the car?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who put the hood on the car?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He had one side and I had the other.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. After he put the car there, what do you do next?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: With, how's, the license plates were taken off the car, who did that?
